productData.name: FT502 lite
productData.description:
• 4 PQs were conducted until now. 
    • PQ1 : May 2025-> The first phase was executed to meet an urgent order of 349,000 pieces. It achieved passing yields across all processes, including 98.88% for UV dispensing and 99.16% for registration.
    • PQ2: December 2025 -> This run confirmed process stability, with all processes from UV dispensing to registration passing validation. The registration yield achieved was 99.00% with a UPH of 4036.
    • PQ3: January 2026 ->Cutting yield suffered from misalignment due to an unmodified jig
      • Suspect root cause from thinner Peco fabric than batch recieved from PQ1 & PQ2???
      • Start proposing to enlarge antenna pitch from 9mm to 9.2mm
    • PQ4: June 2026 
      • Start implementing new pitch 9.2mm -> Cutting misalignment still unsolve
      • Additional issue of bubble in cured glue start ocurring
        • An additional UV lamp was added to mitigate bubble formation -> Solved the issue
        • Checking the inspection method??? (10.09.2026)
  • Suspect root cause of 2 main issues
    • Cutting misalignment
      • According to tool & product design tolerance stacking from Giuseppe, the minimum antenna pitch should be 9.5mm to mitigrate cutting issue.
    • Bubble in cured glue & Module not fully cured
      • Regarding lower mesh density of Peco resulting higher chance the glue is submerge into fabric from the far end side for dispensing creating bubble in glue and glue not fully cover the module as some of them is submerged into fabric before it is being cured. That the reason why using additional UV lamp at the far end side is solve this issue.
Action plan to implement in PQ5 to solve these 2 issues
  • As Q600 fabric has more mesh desity with similar price as Peco, Q600 is worth testing to improve bubble in glue and module not fully covered -> The trial of 1 flame was conduct and has better result without using additional UV lamp
  • Implement new antenna pitch 9.5mm to improve cutting issues -> The trial of 1 flame was conduct and has better cutting result.
  • Revert back to use original bubble criteria as we might be use over quality criteria
PQ5: September 2026
  • TID team agreed to use Q600 fabric + 9.5mm to perform PQ5 to confirm the hypothesis (40k pcs).
    • This workorder was completed with 98.25% (38,296/ 38,977) cutting yield -> Improved from 96.xx% (Peco + 9.2mm)
    • Module not fully covered defect is 3.42% -> Improved from 4.3% (Peco)
